title: The Pilot
script:
INT. ROADSIDE DINER - NIGHT

Rain on the window. RIO wipes down the counter. Nobody else is here.

RIO: We close in ten minutes.

The door opens. SAM steps in, shaking off the rain.

SAM: Then I'll be quick.

He sits. She doesn't stop wiping. He sets an envelope on the counter.

SAM: You left this at my house. In 1994.

She looks at it. One eyebrow goes up.

RIO: Coffee's extra.

CUT TO BLACK.

title: The Second One
script:
INT. ROADSIDE DINER - DAY

RIO opens the envelope.

RIO: Huh.

CUT TO BLACK.
